column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for the commercial event (transaction). PK.
TEXT. Secondary unique tag for cross-system correlation. Example: DN541412.
TIMESTAMP. Datetime when the transaction event was recorded. Example: 2024/4/2.
TEXT. Code of the platform where the transaction occurred. FK to markets(PlatCode).
TEXT. Identifier of the vendor involved in the transaction. FK to vendors(SellerKey). Example: V63085.
TEXT. Identifier of the buyer involved in the transaction. FK to buyers(AcqCode). Example: B41538.
TEXT. Geographical origin region of the shipment. Possible values: Region_A, Region_B, Region_C, Unknown.
TEXT. Destination region of the shipment. Possible values: Region_X, Region_Y, Region_Z, Unknown.
BOOLEAN. Indicates whether the shipment crosses national borders. Possible values: No, Yes.
TEXT. Complexity classification of the shipping route. Possible values: Complex, Medium, Simple.
text. The rate at which transactions are completed, measured in USD/hour. Example: 45.67 USD/hour.
text. The premium associated with cross-border transactions, calculated based on payment amount and cross-border flag. Example: 78.04 USD/border-crossing.
text. The geographical distance involved in the transaction, measured in km. Example: 137.66 USD/border-crossing.

JSONB column. Contains financial details related to the transaction, such as value, fees, escrow usage, and shipping costs.
